name: Total Metamorphosis
source:
Three days after a sweet, troubled stranger ends up crashing at their place, the protagonist Tasia is locked into a time-loop which resets with their death, of which the gamemaster is an eccentric deity who calls herself the Angel of Fate.

Get closely acquainted with two girls who have bad, bad intentions with Tasia!
Uncover the past between the main trio!
Try really hard not to die this time and the next time and the next time!

[From [url=https://angelprism.itch.io/total-metamorphosis]itch.io[/url]]
